root_distance_max_sec.description: Maximum acceptable root distance (in seconds) for time sources. Larger values allow synchronization with less accurate sources.

poll_interval_max_sec.description: Maximum polling interval (in seconds) between time queries to NTP servers. Larger values reduce network traffic but increase clock drift tolerance.

poll_interval_min_sec.description: Minimum polling interval (in seconds) between time queries. Prevents excessive queries to NTP servers.

fallback_ntp_servers.description: List of fallback NTP server hostnames or IP addresses used if primary servers are unreachable.

items.description: A single NTP server (hostname or IPv4/IPv6 address).

ntp_servers.description: List of preferred NTP server hostnames or IP addresses. If empty, only fallback servers are used.

items.description: A single NTP server (hostname or IPv4/IPv6 address).

use_ipv4.description: Enable or disable IPv4 NTP communication.

use_ipv6.description: Enable or disable IPv6 NTP communication.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (quiet), 1 (minimal), 2 (debug). Higher values increase detail in system logs.

retry_sec.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying a failed time synchronization attempt.
